definitions.explanation: A structured contest in which two sides argue for and against a set proposition under fixed rules, and judges decide the winner. Associated with classrooms and competitions rather than everyday argument.

notes:
From English "debate." Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb: ディベート⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ディベート⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: debate tournament
- ディベート⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: a debate class
- ディベート⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧: to win a debate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧: discussion, debate — the Sino-Japanese word, used of panel discussions and parliamentary debate
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧: argument, discussion — the general everyday word, with no rules or winner
- ⟦{口論|こうろん}→口論：08371_kouron⟧: quarrel — an emotional dispute, not an organized exchange
